fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: Whips the segmented blade out at the first enemy within 5 tiles, where it deals 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Unspooled Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes the unlinked blade in a full circle that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves them [Hindered] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Segmented Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: One More Shackle
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
